summary: ArcelorMittal filed a Form 6-K reporting a press release about a missile strike on its Ukraine plant, ArcelorMittal Kryvyi Rih, on August 17, 2026. The attack injured 13 employees and contractors, tragically killing two individuals. The plant was operational at the time; main facilities for energy and blast furnace production suffered damage, partially halting production. Specialists are assessing damage extent and restoration timelines. The filing is a routine operational update, not a special-situation corporate event. No transaction terms, recommendations, or advisors are involved. What to watch: impact on production and potential operational recovery updates.
